findings.bug: Test name and Phase 8 VERIFICATION credit `--all-shots` surfacing the broken unselected shot, but the test only calls LoadAndResolveShot; no automated assertion exercises ValidateAllShots/CLI --all-shots (manual one-liner only).
findings.predicted: Regression in project-wide shot aggregation can ship green while selected-shot paths still pass.
findings.fix_hint: Add a Go test that validates broken_unselected with all-shots mode and asserts a diagnostic for shot `bad` while documenting selected-shot success separately.

findings.bug: Roadmap/MOD-02 require offline rejection of import-depth, per-file bytes, total project bytes, module-count, and absolute paths; resolve.go emits LIM_IMPORT_DEPTH/LIM_FILE_BYTES/LIM_PROJECT_BYTES/LIM_MODULES/PROJ_PATH_ABS but no *_test.go covers those codes (only cycle/missing/escape/symlink/aggregate objects).
findings.predicted: Depth/byte/count/absolute-path bypasses can land without failing CI despite containment claims.
findings.fix_hint: Add negative fixtures and assert exact codes for depth>8, oversized file, project-byte overrun, >32 modules, and absolute module path.

findings.bug: After expecting any error, acceptance is nearly tautological: nonempty Message plus 'object'/32/`/objects` marks found=true, so many non-LIM diagnostics satisfy the check; VERIFICATION claims LIM_OBJECTS specifically.
findings.predicted: Broken or removed aggregate object enforcement can still pass if any objects-related error is returned.
findings.fix_hint: Require Code == LIM_OBJECTS (or the single documented code) and fail on other codes.

findings.bug: Escape rejection accepts PROJ_PATH_ESCAPE or PROJ_FILE_MISSING, so a containment miss that degrades to missing-file still passes the adversarial path case.
findings.predicted: Path-escape regressions are masked as generic missing-file failures.
findings.fix_hint: Pin PROJ_PATH_ESCAPE for `../` traversal; keep FILE_MISSING only on the dedicated missing_file fixture with an explicit code assert.

findings.bug: Plan gate asks for equivalent Blender scene properties/render outputs; test proves compile-byte equality then only os.Stat on PNG/blend—no reopen probe comparing IDs/transforms/materials between modular and flat.
findings.predicted: Runtime binding divergence between modular and flat can pass while both produce nonempty artifacts.
findings.fix_hint: Reuse title/scene probe helpers to assert equivalent probed properties (and optionally image tolerance) for both previews.

findings.bug: S04 requires concurrent shot builds plus one failed shot with success/failure attributed correctly; the integration test only runs three successful previews and checks distinct job dirs.
findings.predicted: A failed concurrent shot can pollute sibling manifests/outputs or be mis-attributed without CI noticing.
findings.fix_hint: Extend concurrent shot test with one deliberately failing shot and assert isolation of success manifests vs failure for the right IDs.

findings.bug: Named as supported-brief evaluation but only validate/compile/preview + PNG existence for hand-authored fixtures—no checklist assertions (text, lens, frame counts, chart values). Playbook warns fixtures ≠ NL authoring; STATE still blocks LLM repair-loop evidence.
findings.predicted: Fixture drift that still renders a PNG is treated as brief/gate evidence; LLM ≥10/12 claim remains untested and easy to overstate.
findings.fix_hint: Rename/clarify as fixture smoke; add per-fixture structural oracles for brief checklists; keep LLM repair-loop explicitly blocked until model runs exist.

findings.bug: Automated suite only asserts ParseAndValidate ErrorList on schema/semantic poison JSON (unknown asset, raw python field, etc.); playbook unsupported prompts (arbitrary .blend/Python, download/rig, huge limits, MP4) have no automated agent-refusal oracle.
findings.predicted: Capability-boundary refusals for U-prompts can regress while fixture rejections stay green.
findings.fix_hint: Document fixture IDs as schema negatives only; add separate blocked/pending cases for NL unsupported refusals until an agent eval harness exists.

findings.bug: Linear midpoint and step-hold have Blender probes; ease_in_out (declared in schema/fixtures) has no interior-sample probe matching B05.
findings.predicted: Wrong easing binding can ship while step/linear remain green.
findings.fix_hint: Add a Blender frame probe for ease_in_out interior samples against the documented curve contract.

findings.bug: Only asserts err != nil; no ErrorList/code pin (unlike cycle/symlink).
findings.predicted: Wrong failure mode (panic recovered elsewhere, IO wrap) still counts as coverage for missing dependencies.
findings.fix_hint: Assert diag.ErrorList with PROJ_MODULE_MISSING or PROJ_FILE_MISSING as documented.
